title: cistus albidus subsp. varius
intro: Cistus albidus subsp. varius, commonly known as the white rockrose, is a subspecies of the Cistus albidus plant, a flowering evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cistus albidus subsp. varius include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, making it a valuable remedy for skin and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
